notes: Each month's ranking is the one on the first day of the next month, from the meets held before it as the archive has them now (it fills in for weeks); Now adds every meet since. Our rating also moves with time since the last meet, so a lifter can move without lifting.

The top 100 of our ranking (3+ scored meets, one in the last 400 days; the ranking file lists the top 3,000). The bar splits the rating by each lift's share of the best total of the last 12 months. Form: the last five meets against our pre-meet forecast (W beat it, L fell short). Colours only tell the lines apart.
Weight classes: the IPF classes at the lifter's latest bodyweight; lifts are the best of the last two years.
